risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (341), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and imminent FOMC event create severely adverse macro conditions for discretionary equities despite 92-day earnings buffer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Dual MACD crossovers + rising RSI across all periods with price above all major moving averages (9/21/50/200) and Ichimoku cloud alignment provide solid momentum confluence for a swing entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme macro headwinds (VIX crisis at 341, flat yield curve, rising dollar, imminent FOMC), weak ADX trend conviction (11.28), Bollinger Band squeeze limiting follow-through, and no fundamental/insider support make this a high-risk entry in an unfavourable environment.
